text-watermark-paraphrase

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:text-watermark-paraphrase` → `ai-text-watermark-paraphrase` → `src/demos/ai/ai-text-watermark-paraphrase`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/206`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#22-text-watermark-paraphrase`. **Packet:** P1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:temperature-sampling`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** temperature-sampling changes token preferences; this computes a marked-token test and an explicit rewrite channel that weakens detection.

**Computed primary model:** Eight binary token classesG/R, nulliidP(G)=.5. Detectorflags iff≥7G: exact null falsepositiveP=9/256=.03515625. Toy marked generatoriidP(G)=.8 has flagprobability.50331648. Supplied sequenceGGGGGGGR flags; declared rewrite changes its first2G toR, leaving5G and no flag. Symbol pairs are stipulated interchangeable in this fictional message; no real paraphrase semantics are measured.

**Countercase / boundary:** Independent rewrite channel turns eachG toR withprobability.25 and never RtoG: effectiveP(G)=.6, detector probability.10637568. A flag is statistical evidence under its null, not guaranteed authorship; a nonflag after rewriting does not prove human origin or universal watermark removal.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether the same underlying message can cross this threshold after rewriting; recall assumptions about iidtoken classes and channel define the claimed false-positive/detection rates.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Count/test original then Rewrite exposes exact edited positions and recomputed count; Channel view enumerates binomial outcomes/rates while retaining7→5 witness. No detector network service or externally copied text.

**Source obligation:** [Kirchenbauer et al. original PDF](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/kirchenbauer23a/kirchenbauer23a.pdf), opened2026-10-19, green-list statistical detection framework. Exact8-token binomial model/channel are local simplifications, not its hash-dependent real-model protocol, z-test calibration or empirical paraphrase results.
